scope: Object pictures (80:ACD0, 80:B20A) in address order. address: the picture as frames name it; shadow: signed byte before the picture, times 4 to FE0, present when bits 0-2 of the first cell are not 0; tiles: per slot the two 64-byte OBJ character sources for the NMI 81:A964; width, height (times 2 to DP 1A/1D); rows, columns; cells: one byte per cell, columns first (bit 5 empty, bits 6-7 flip). See src/data/pictures.mjs.
